textbookBox.concept: The king was surprised and threw a grape again. Again the farmer said Thank God and called himself blessed. The king asked why he was thanking God when grapes were being thrown at him.

beats.en: A journey is a trip from one place to another. A guard protects a place and a royal garden is the garden of a king. Popped means put something quickly into the mouth. Wise means clever and sensible.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Thank God · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Words that have the opposite meaning are called opposites. Heavy is the opposite of light. A thick book is opposed by a thin book. A long journey is opposed by a short journey.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from Thank God: Words that have the opposite meaning are called opposites. Heavy is the opposite of light. A thick book is opposed by a thin book. A long journey is opposed by a short journey.
